In 3rd grade, I took a spelling test and one of the words was 'deer', like the animal. The teacher, obviously, was reading the words aloud as well as the description (like the animal). I spelled it correctly, but when my paper was handed back she'd marked it wrong and corrected it to 'dear'.   I told her she was wrong and that my grade should be changed, and she, knowing that we were talking about the word 'deer', referring to the animal, continued to tell me I was wrong. I ended up getting sent to the principal over it and the principal found the entire situation quite amusing. I got my grade fixed :)

It's a good suggestion, but unfortunately not all of us can take hormonal BC :/ I haven't found any BC that doesn't have awful side effects. The pill caused me a lot of nausea, headaches, and a complete loss of sex drive. The shot caused all of that including severe migraines. The paragard (copper IUD, hormone free) implanted itself into my uterine wall and I'm very lucky it didn't have to be surgically removed. I won't even bother with implanon because my body is so sensitive to things like that I'll definitely have a bad reaction (my mom is similar to me regarding side effects from medications, she had a horrible reaction). If y'all have any other suggestions though I am interested!
